facts.statement: On day 8 of the SOE 12 Days of Holidays promotion, Free Realms offered double Station Cash on redemptions made until 21 December at 08:59 CET.
facts.quote: Heute ist der 8. Tag der " SOE 12 Days of Holidays"-Promotion!

article_summaries.title: Doppel Station Cash - nur für eine begrenzte Zeit
article_summaries.summary: A German-language Free Realms news post announcing a limited-time double Station Cash promotion, run as day 8 of SOE's "12 Days of Holidays" promotion. Double Station Cash applied to Station Cash purchased in-game, via a Station account, or by redeeming an SOE Pre-Paid Game Card, until 21 December at 08:59 CET. The post gives no year, so the exact date is unknown.
